title: lobelia flaccida var. stricta
intro: Lobelia flaccida var. stricta, commonly known as Cardinal Flower, is a perennial plant native to North America. It is used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its use as a diuretic and expectorant. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia flaccida var. stricta include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
